protocol.scope: Fixed cycle3 34 exposed development inputs, 14 complete families, both backbones. Not independent; no replacement of historical121.
protocol.hypothesis: Current subject/time/polarity binding in a short target-selection proposal may improve complete native readout beyond ordinary targeted reconsideration using the same retrieved knowledge.
protocol.contrast: Scoped versus ordinary: same material, schema, two-call hard caps. Verdict-only: exact scoped proposal with reason removed; identical final prompt, complete evidence still present. This tests generated-rationale content, not evidence removal or pure independence.
protocol.proposal_semantics: YES/NO means include/exclude target in the native answer to the complete question as worded, not unconditional medical truth. UNRESOLVED means the intermediate judgment is inconclusive.
protocol.source_use: Model judgments are unverified. Retrieved general knowledge does not invent current patient facts or override stated hypothetical premises.
protocol.prior_experiments: Cycle1 already tested B visibility on8; cycle2 tested target judgments without added retrieval. This is a new retrieved-condition/readout comparison, not their first implementation.
protocol.absent_target_policy: Four M4 failed queries remain failed and in denominator. Each final independently uses complete input; no new target, no failed prefix, no proposal call. M5 d00050 unavailable B retained in all3 arms.
protocol.optional_proposal_policy: Parse/truncation warnings do not suppress final generation; no proposal retry or extraction from unfinished JSON. Final native invalid gets exactly one format repair per arm.
protocol.exact_request_policy: Each arm is a separately executed prescribed draw; no within-run cross-arm response cache. Same seed and possible identical missing-target requests are recorded, not repeated until correctness.
protocol.failure_policy: Ordinary item errors continue with full denominators. Wrong binding/model/leakage or broken shared infrastructure stops affected run.
protocol.expansion_policy: No automatic full121 or independent expansion. If main does not beat B and ordinary control, preserve negative candidate and stop this version.
protocol.cost_policy: Only new proposals/readouts generate now. Saved B/query/tools cost separately attributed. Verdict-only includes shared scoped proposal acquisition; do not double-count physical spend. Equal caps do not mean equal actual expense.
